items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I found Salsbury, so he told me he'd finish the night on piano.

ctx.x: I said, 'no, no, not now.' They says, 'yeah, we've got to.' They says, 'that's why we're here.' I says, 'well, wait a minute, look here, I've got to finish tonight. Let me get through tonight and then we'll go up after I finish the dance.' They said, 'well, truthfully, we can't do that because we told them we'd bring you in right away. We were supposed to have taken you in at 9:00.'
I said, 'well, wait a minute, I'll find somebody to play in my place.' I found Salsbury, so he told me he'd finish the night on piano.

items.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: So luckily, George Salsbury, a piano player was there in the dressing room so I called George over, so George finished the gig for me that night.

ctx.x: They don’t fool around with that, did they?

No they didn’t fool around. The guy told me he says, he was real nice at first, we took intermission you know, and we took intermission and he says, “we’ve got some important business we’ve got to talk to you” and there’s two of them. They says, he says, “we’d appreciate it if you’d finish everything you’ve got to do, so we can get to this business.” So I kept fooling around, so they came back to me and says, “look I’ll tell you something.” They says, “We don’t want to upset you or nothing, but we’ve got — here…
